data_processing.title: Data processing
data_processing.desc: Needed to store wave answers and build reports. Data is kept on servers in Uzbekistan.

third_party_transfer.title: Sharing with olympiad partners
third_party_transfer.desc: Olympiad organisers and the schools hosting the final receive your child’s name, grade and olympiad result. Wave history is never shared.

marketing.title: News and offers
marketing.desc: SMS about new olympiads and Zinapo features. Wave reminders don’t depend on this.
